mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_rt_ai_conversation (user_id, title, model, scene, message_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{model}, #{scene}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_rt_ai_conversation SET title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_rt_ai_conversation SET message_count = message_count + #{count}, model = #{model} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_rt_ai_conversation SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, model, scene, message_count, create_time, update_time FROM tb_rt_ai_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_rt_ai_message (conversation_id, role, content, tokens, cost_ms, sources) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{tokens}, #{costMs}, #{sources})
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, tokens, cost_ms, sources, create_time FROM tb_rt_ai_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_rt_ai_conversation WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_rt_ai_message WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_rt_ai_message WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= CURDATE()
SELECT model AS model, COUNT(*) AS total FROM tb_rt_ai_conversation WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY model ORDER BY total DESC
